toml:
name = "orders_demo"
default_target = "demo"

[defaults]
pipeline_mode = "direct"
kafka_broker_list = "redpanda.localhost:19092"

[connection]
host = "localhost"
port = 18123
username = "clickhouse"
password = "clickhouse"

[targets.demo]
database = "orders_demo"

[audit_scheduler]
enabled = true

[sensors]
enabled = true
tick_retention_days = 7

[targets.python]
analyzer = "python"
root = "."
roots = ["src/sqltide"]
tests = ["tests"]
tooling = ["scripts"]
rule_modules = [
  "scripts.fensu_policy.classes.workflow_authority_policy",
  "scripts.fensu_policy.rules.adapter_ownership",
  "scripts.fensu_policy.rules.event_catalog_authority",
  "scripts.fensu_policy.rules.observability_authority",
  "scripts.fensu_policy.rules.sql_analysis_boundary",
  "scripts.fensu_policy.rules.workflow_authority",
]
select = ["FF", "XSQT"]

[targets.python.cache]
enabled = true
require_cacheable = true

[targets.python.evaluation]
exclude = ["tests/e2e/fixtures/**"]

[[targets.python.rule_exceptions]]
rule = "FFR402"
path = "src/sqltide/sensors/__init__.py"
reason = "Authored project sensors import the public sensor API from sqltide.sensors, so this package initializer re-exports the closed authored surface exactly as the CHI-18 specification defines it."

[[targets.python.rule_exceptions]]
rule = "FFR402"
path = "src/sqltide/events/__init__.py"
reason = "Authored project sensors import derived event types from sqltide.events, so this package initializer re-exports the closed authored surface exactly as the CHI-18 specification defines it."

[[targets.python.rule_exceptions]]
rule = "FFS120"
path = "src/sqltide/sensors/classes/event_sensor_context.py"
symbols = ["EventSensorContext.step"]
reason = "The authored durable-step API is ctx.step(key, fn, policy=...) with positional key and callable per the CHI-18 specification; keyword-only parameters would break the documented authored ergonomics."

[[targets.python.rule_exceptions]]
rule = "FFS120"
path = "src/sqltide/sensors/classes/durable_step_runner.py"
symbols = ["DurableStepRunner.run"]
reason = "DurableStepRunner.run backs the authored ctx.step(key, fn, policy=...) signature, so its parameters mirror that positional authored contract."

[[targets.python.rule_exceptions]]
rule = "FFT104"
path = "tests/e2e/src/sqltide/dev_server/helpers.py"
symbols = ["wait_for_sensor_first_dispatch", "wait_for_sensor_dead_letter"]
reason = "These wait_for_* helpers poll the dev server until sensor dispatch state is reached asynchronously. A bounded retry loop and its readiness condition are the wait itself, so they cannot be expressed branch-free."

[[targets.python.rule_exceptions]]
rule = "FFT104"
path = "tests/e2e/src/sqltide/executor/helpers.py"
symbols = ["wait_for_query_view_activity", "wait_for_row_count", "wait_for_state_model_activity", "wait_for_table_exists", "wait_for_table_missing"]
reason = "These wait_for_* helpers poll for state reached asynchronously. A bounded retry loop and its early return are the wait condition, so they cannot be expressed branch-free. Every other conditional in this module has been removed."

[[targets.python.rule_exceptions]]
rule = "FFT003"
path = "tests/unit/examples/orders_demo/producer/test_fake_orders_producer.py"
reason = "The runnable orders-demo producer lives outside the installable package; these tests mirror that checked-in example rather than a runtime package root."

[[targets.python.rule_exceptions]]
rule = "FFT003"
path = "tests/unit/examples/orders_demo/producer/_test_types.py"
reason = "The runnable orders-demo producer lives outside the installable package; this local test-case role supports tests for that checked-in example."

[targets.web]
analyzer = "svelte"
root = "ui"
roots = ["src"]
tests = ["tests"]
tooling = []
test_layout = "mirrored"
framework = "sveltekit"
ui_kit = "src/ui-kit"
shadcn = "components.json"
rule_packs = []
select = ["FW"]

toml:
# Python that stays once Rust hosts SQLTide. Every other Python file under src/sqltide is
# migration work that moves to Rust. `remaining_lines` must equal the current count of that work:
# a PR that moves code lowers it, and adding movable Python fails the check.
# Each `[[stays]]` entry names the one rule that keeps it Python and a note with the evidence:
# 1 = executor or adapter runtime and the shapes it consumes; 2 = thin shim that invokes user
# Python; 3 = public facade (facade only); 4 = glue around a Python-only third-party library.
# A file is listed only once it holds nothing but that role: a runtime, shim or facade file that
# still carries planning, validation, rendering or other movable logic counts as movable until
# that logic moves to Rust.
# Native failures must surface as errors; `handled_native_errors` lists the reviewed exceptions.
remaining_lines = 64107
